executive_overview.change_since_prior_release: Five newly discovered reviews entered the refreshed rolling year and two records aged out. Fleet stability and Driver workflow friction each gained one corroborating review; all ranks and recommendations remain unchanged.
executive_overview.decision: Fund two immediate diagnostic tracks - Fleet mobile stability/access and Driver HOS state integrity - while adding a release-experience gate for Driver stability and workflow burden.
executive_overview.headline: Fleet stability is the urgent signal; Driver HOS integrity is the highest-consequence signal.
executive_overview.platform_interpretation: Fleet Android has a much more negative public-review mix, but both Fleet platforms identify stability as the central problem. The evidence does not establish different underlying platform problems.
executive_overview.recent_signal: Driver stability and workflow friction are rising in recent reviews. Both warrant investigation, but public reviews alone cannot connect the movement to a specific release. We did not find enough evidence to claim that any theme is improving.

methodology.access_limits: No App Store Connect, Google Play Console, internal telemetry, incidents, support, account, or release data were available.
methodology.ai_use: AI assisted research design, classification support, coding, QA, and drafting; human review and deterministic checks governed published claims.
methodology.claim_boundary: Public reviews prioritize investigation; they do not establish all-customer prevalence, root cause, release causality, or platform causality.
methodology.next_week: Join top themes to internal telemetry and support, validate proposed owners and thresholds, repair response-timing anomalies, and activate the private scheduled workflow.

recommendations.name: Fleet mobile stability
recommendations.proposed_owner: Fleet Mobile Product & Engineering; partners: Identity & Access and Observability
recommendations.recommendation: Open a cross-platform reliability workstream covering crash, load, blank-state, and map paths.

recommendations.name: Fleet access and recovery
recommendations.proposed_owner: Fleet Mobile Product & Engineering; partners: Identity & Access and Observability
recommendations.recommendation: Instrument session expiry, failed re-entry, MFA delivery, restart loops, reinstall, and app-data deletion.

recommendations.name: Driver HOS state integrity
recommendations.proposed_owner: Driver HOS Product & Engineering; partners: Compliance and Support
recommendations.recommendation: Join review evidence to duty-state transitions, sync delays, warnings, support cases, and incidents.

recommendations.name: Driver workflow friction
recommendations.proposed_owner: Mobile Engineering / Release Quality; partners: Driver Product, Design, and QA
recommendations.recommendation: Reduce interaction count and regression burden in vehicle selection, DVIR, HOS, and navigation.

recommendations.name: Driver app stability
recommendations.proposed_owner: Mobile Engineering / Release Quality; partners: Driver Product, Design, and QA
recommendations.recommendation: Gate releases on responsiveness and stability across app version, OS, device, and workflow cohorts.

recommendations.name: Fleet map stability
recommendations.proposed_owner: Fleet Mobile Product & Engineering; partner: Observability
recommendations.recommendation: Diagnose failing map paths inside the broader Fleet stability workstream.

recommendations.name: Driver safety and AI false detections
recommendations.recommendation: Investigate perceived false detections and strengthen review and appeal paths.

recommendations.name: Driver control and simplification requests
recommendations.proposed_owner: Driver Product and Design Research; coordinated by Product Operations
recommendations.recommendation: Treat recurring restore, simplify, control, and status requests as a discovery portfolio.

recommendations.name: Fleet product requests
recommendations.proposed_owner: Fleet Product Discovery; coordinated by Product Operations
recommendations.recommendation: Monitor sparse Fleet requests rather than elevate them as a roadmap priority.

themes.name: Driver safety and AI false detections
